The label on the side of the iron contains text that is illegible and structurally nonsensical. The characters appear melted or alien-like, a common failure mode in AI-generated images when rendering small print.

The connection between the power cord and the iron's body lacks a clear strain relief or plug housing. The cord seems to merge slightly into the plastic casing rather than having a distinct mechanical connector.
